narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating obligated $916M in FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating received 2 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $458M, and obligations were up 361.8% year over year. American Centrifuge Operating has a history of smaller obligations in prior years: FY21 was $38.9M, FY22 was $42.9M, FY23 was $50M, FY24 was $85M, and FY25 was $198M. American Centrifuge Operating’s FY2026 obligations are concentrated in a small set of markets. American Centrifuge Operating recorded $900M in Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing and $15.9M in Nuclear Electric Power Generation for FY2026 to date. American Centrifuge Operating’s current-year totals are partial because figures represent fiscal year to date obligations. American Centrifuge Operating’s award-value totals in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values rather than obligations. This profile highlights the recent step change in federal dollars to American Centrifuge Operating and the markets that received the bulk of FY2026 funding.

sections.body: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing drove the majority of FY2026 obligations, totaling $900M. Nuclear Electric Power Generation accounted for $15.9M. The two listed NAICS markets represent the main recorded industry allocations for FY2026 to date.

sections.heading: How did American Centrifuge Operating’s funding change compared with prior years?
